summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Eni S.p.A., an Italian oil & gas company, reporting its routine share buybacks conducted on Euronext Milan from June 15–19, 2026. Under the second tranche of a treasury share program (approved May 6, 2026), Eni repurchased 4,583,344 shares (0.15% of capital) at a weighted average price of €21.8181/share for a total of ~€100M. Since the program's start on May 8, 2026, Eni has bought 20,028,482 shares (0.66% of capital) for ~€460M, now holding 3.53% of capital. The buyback is funded from retained capital and aimed at returning excess cash to shareholders as additional remuneration beyond dividends. No premium, target, or acquisition is involved. Watch for continued repurchase execution, market price support, and potential EPS accretion.
